segmentation.targets: verified expert maps, 64 x 64 (8 x 8-pixel cells)

caveats: scan groups are reconstructed from tumour runs, not verified patient volumes
every group contains tumour: volume-level specificity cannot be measured
no voxel spacing in the PNG slices: sizes in voxels (8 x 8-pixel cells)

cnn.feature_description: 64-d embedding (penultimate layer) of the selected V9 2.5-D CNN (cnn25d_v9_a4_res_se_focal, trained on the training split only)

backend.noise: noise-free unless stated (noise study in quantum_experiments.json)

cnn.note: test AUC of every configuration is listed for transparency; only validation AUC was used to choose

eff.feature_description: GAP features (1280-d) of V8's fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 (trained on the training split only)

backend.noise: noise-free unless stated (noise study in quantum_experiments.json)

eff.note: test AUC of every configuration is listed for transparency; only validation AUC was used to choose

g01_analysis.acquisition_metadata: not available: the slices are windowed PNG images without DICOM headers (no scanner, kernel, contrast phase or voxel spacing)

not_trained.convnext_tiny_ft_v9: ImageNet weights not available offline (no network access)
not_trained.efficientnet_b2_ft_v9: ImageNet weights not available offline (no network access)
not_trained.unet3d_v9: no contiguous labelled volumes with spacing; 2 CPU cores; the 2.5-D U-Net is the trained segmentation model
not_trained.nnunet_v9: requires PyTorch, which cannot be installed offline
not_trained.pennylane_qiskit: not installable offline; all circuits use the project's exact NumPy state-vector simulator
not_trained.external_validation: no external CT dataset reachable (no network access)
not_trained.genuine_volume_ids: original LiTS volumes not available; scan groups remain reconstructed (scripts/v9_recover_volume_ids.py ready)

quantum_execution: All circuits were run on a NumPy exact state-vector simulator (noise study uses simulated depolarizing noise and shots). No quantum hardware was used.
